name: Liebert & Liebert CPA
tagline: Numbers Made Simple. Time Always Given.
brandNarrative:
At Liebert & Liebert CPA, the clock doesn't run out when your questions do. When Hunter Jones arrived 45 minutes late to his appointment, Mark didn't cut things short — he stayed until nearly 6 PM, walking through every detail until the commission-based tax picture was clear. That kind of unhurried, person-first approach is the throughline in everything this firm does. Located in a understated storefront on NE Broadway in Portland, this is the kind of place where complex becomes comprehensible and no one makes you feel behind for asking.

Richard brings deep technical knowledge to clients navigating genuinely complicated situations. Amy Bangsund had never needed tax help before, but when a complex year arrived, Richard sat with her and her family and turned overwhelming into manageable. That's the real differentiator here — not software, not speed, but the willingness to actually sit with someone and share expertise in a way that lands. Mark and Richard represent a firm that believes understanding matters as much as accuracy.

With a 4.4-star rating across a tight but telling set of reviews, Liebert & Liebert earns its reputation through individual relationships rather than volume. The firm operates Monday through Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM, with the kind of consistent, professional hours that signal stability. One reviewer noted the absence of a website with curiosity rather than frustration — because when the people inside are this good, word of mouth does the work.
ownerStory:
Mark Liebert is the kind of CPA who stays late — not because the billing meter is running, but because a client still has questions. When a commission salesman walked in 45 minutes behind schedule and still needed to untangle a complicated financial picture, Mark didn't redirect or rush. He explained things in plain language, stayed past closing, and made sure the client left with clarity. That patience isn't a policy. It's a personality.

Alongside Richard, who brings the kind of expertise that first-time tax clients genuinely need when life gets financially complicated, the Liebert team has quietly built something rare: an accounting firm where people feel helped rather than processed. The firm's NE Broadway location has the feel of a trusted neighborhood institution — gray doors, arched windows, no flashy signage — which matches the firm's character perfectly. They're not trying to impress you with aesthetics. They're trying to get your taxes right.

faq.question: Do you work with clients who have complicated or unusual tax situations?
faq.answer: Absolutely. Liebert & Liebert regularly works with commission-based salespeople, clients experiencing major financial life changes, and first-time filers navigating complex years. Both Mark and Richard are experienced in making complicated situations understandable.

faq.question: What can I expect from my first appointment?
faq.answer: A real conversation with a knowledgeable CPA who will take the time to understand your situation. Clients consistently note that Mark and Richard never make them feel rushed — appointments run as long as they need to, even past business hours when necessary.

faq.question: Are you currently accepting new clients?
faq.answer: Availability for new clients can be limited during peak tax season. One caller in January 2026 was told new clients weren't being taken at that time. It's best to call ahead at (503) 287-4992 to check current availability and schedule early.

faq.question: Do you have a website where I can learn more or book an appointment?
faq.answer: At this time, Liebert & Liebert does not have a website. The best way to connect is to call the office directly at (503) 287-4992 during business hours, Monday through Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: What makes Liebert & Liebert different from a large tax chain like H&R Block?
faq.answer: The difference is time and expertise. You're meeting with a licensed CPA — not a seasonal employee — who will sit with you, learn your situation, and explain things in plain language. Clients who've had complex situations specifically sought out Liebert & Liebert for the depth of knowledge and personal attention.

faq.question: What are your office hours and where are you located?
faq.answer: The office is open Monday through Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM, and is located at 4300 NE Broadway, Suite 3, Portland, Oregon. Parking is available on-site. The office is closed on weekends.

brandColors.note: Deep navy anchors the brand in trust, stability, and professional credibility — exactly what you want from a CPA. Dark goldenrod as the accent adds warmth and a subtle nod to value without feeling corporate or cold. Together they evoke the feel of a trusted, established office rather than a flashy franchise.
